bricks.description: GRADING: tungsten-balanced night film emulation: cool cyan-slate shadows, honest natural skin warmth, a gentle red halation blooming around bright lights, smooth rolled-off highlights.
bricks.when: Night streets, neon, a film still.

bricks.description: GRADING: black-and-white film stock: rich midtone silver gradation, crisp blacks without muddy compression, fine uniform grain, strictly no colour.
GRADING: warm portrait colour-negative look: soft contrast, creamy skin tones, gentle pastel greens and blues, slightly lifted shadows and fine grain.
GRADING: classic slide film: deep saturated reds and blues, dense shadows, crisp contrast and a slightly warm mid-century tone.
bricks.when: Nostalgia, the sixties, a holiday postcard.

bricks.description: GRADING: vivid landscape slide film: punchy saturated greens and blues, strong contrast, deep skies and luminous colour.
bricks.when: Nature, a big open space, joy.
